headline: Banreservas Obtains Guarantee of Up to US$100 Million to Finance Foreign Trade
summary: Dominican bank Banreservas signed an agreement with the International Finance Corporation, a World Bank Group member. The guarantee of up to US$100 million will expand its capacity to support import and export operations.
why: Banreservas is a state-linked Dominican lender, and trade finance capacity affects its lending volumes and the businesses it supports.
